title: The Great Deletion | ECHO//100 Episode 49
description: Kavi must purge the corrupted Hundred Phones before they unravel the fabric of their reality. The cost of salvation proves far higher than anyone anticipated. Episode 49 of ECHO//100: ARC. This is a work of original science-fiction, AI-assisted.

scenes.text: The city’s infrastructure is liquefying; every rotary and smartphone is crumbling into shimmering purple sand.
scenes.caption: Phones turning to dust
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot of a city street where vintage phones are dissolving into glowing purple sand particles.

scenes.text: Kavi frantically taps his terminal, watching the Null-Void signal spikes climb toward a critical threshold.
scenes.caption: Kavi hacking the void
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in his red hoodie and glasses, frantically typing on a floating holographic terminal.

scenes.text: Byte’s cyan face flickers, his orange antenna sparking as he locks the synchronization protocol into place.
scenes.caption: Byte locking the protocol
scenes.image_prompt: Byte, a white floating robot, with his orange antenna sparking intensely against a dark void.

scenes.text: The Shadow emerges, his glitching form pulsing with the secrets of a thousand dead, failed timelines.
scenes.caption: The Shadow appears
scenes.image_prompt: The Shadow, a dark silhouette with red eyes, standing amidst swirling purple sand in Null-Void.

scenes.text: To stop the sync, someone must be erased, someone holding the blueprint of the entire loop.
scenes.caption: The ultimate sacrifice
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi and the Shadow staring at each other, a glowing red portal between them.

scenes.text: The Shadow steps forward, offering his own existence as the catalyst for the system-wide purge.
scenes.caption: Shadow offers deletion
scenes.image_prompt: The Shadow pointing to himself, his body beginning to fray into digital static fragments.

scenes.text: Kavi hesitates, then strikes the execution key, feeling the weight of the deletion command ripple outward.
scenes.caption: Kavi executes the purge
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi pressing a glowing red button on his backpack, light surging through his fingers.

scenes.text: Instead of the Shadow, the ground beneath Kavi cracks, and the New World begins dissolving away.
scenes.caption: Reality starts collapsing
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi looking down as the floor of the Null-Void turns into purple sand, falling apart.
